title: Createcraft: Server-Side Modpack
description: Server-side companion for the CreateCraft modpack.
body:
# CreateCraft Server 🔧

The server-side companion modpack for CreateCraft. Drop this on your server and you're ready to go — fully compatible with the CreateCraft client modpack.

Includes all the necessary Create addons, performance mods, and server utilities to run a smooth and stable multiplayer experience.

## Client
This is the server-side companion for the CreateCraft client modpack.
Check it out here: [Createcraft: A New Era](https://modrinth.com/modpack/createcraft-a-new-era)
